title: Use "{title}" via API
description: Copy a request that returns this content from the CMS API.

status.published: Published. The API serves the last published version.
status.changes: Published version available. Republish to include your latest edits.
status.unpublished: Not published. Publish this entry before requesting it. You can copy the request now.
status.archived: Archived. Restore and republish before requesting this entry.
status.legacy: Republish once to make this previously published entry available through the API.
status.unknown: Publication status unavailable. The API serves published content only.
status.folder: Returns published entries in this folder. Drafts and subfolders aren't included. If you moved an entry here, republish it to include it.

steps.keyBody: Use a read-only key for workspace {workspace}, managed in Workspace Admin.
steps.keySkip: Already have a read-only key? Use it with the request below.
steps.copyHelper: $XYNES_API_KEY is a named environment variable. Examples contain no credentials.
steps.urlHeader: URL requests still need the header Authorization: Bearer '<your key>'.
steps.publishBody: The API serves the last published version.
steps.publishInEditor: Use Publish at the top of the editor.
steps.environmentBody: In your shell, enter the key privately with the command below. The request expands the named variable; never use the raw key as its name. Keep keys out of source and shell history. JavaScript examples run on your server.
steps.readiness: Requests also require a configured gateway and a key with CMS read permissions.

copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the code and copy it manually.

options.offsetHelp: To load the next page, add your items-per-page number to this. Check page.hasMore in the response.

preview.note: Example only, not your live content. Fields match your selection.
preview.pagination: The response includes page.hasMore. When it's true, request the next page with a larger skip value.

roadmap: JavaScript SDK and scripts are coming soon.

errors.INVALID_API_BASE_URL: Public API address is missing or invalid. Ask your administrator to configure the public gateway URL.
errors.INVALID_CONTEXT: The workspace or content target is missing or invalid. Reopen the API panel from your workspace.
errors.INVALID_OPTIONS: Use whole numbers within the limits shown and keep search within its character limit.

validation.limit: Enter a whole number from {min, number} to {max, number} items.
validation.offset: Enter a whole number from {min, number} to {max, number} items skipped.
validation.search: Use no more than {max, number} characters.

hosts.configUnavailable: Public API address is missing. Ask your administrator to configure it.
